about: BigV Telecom Private Limited (BTPL) operates as a cloud telephony company, providing telephony solutions to businesses — automated cloud contact centres, missed-call and click-to-call services, IVR, toll-free services and allied products. Incorporated in 2008, registered office at Nagpur, Maharashtra.
industry: Information Technology — IT Consulting & Other Services; Telecom — Mobile Service Providers

pulse.interpretation: Strong tax discipline and clean credit record; the broken EPFO trail is the one signal requiring direct explanation from management.

aiSummary.oneLine: Hyper-growth Nagpur cloud-telephony firm — revenue up ~80× in four years to ₹168.7 Cr, debt fully repaid, ₹13.9 Cr cash — but four governance and compliance signals warrant explanation before extending large credit or partnership.

signals.label: Growth & strength
signals.text: Revenue ₹2.1 Cr (FY21) → ₹168.7 Cr (FY25); EBITDA margin 15.7%; interest coverage 46×; all borrowings repaid during FY25; cash conversion cycle compressed 161 → 36 days.

signals.label: Remuneration vs profit
signals.text: Managerial remuneration of ₹21.8 Cr in FY25 exceeds the year's net profit of ₹19.6 Cr (it was ₹1.8 Cr in FY24).

signals.label: Business-mix shift
signals.text: ₹112.4 Cr stock-in-trade purchases and ₹11.8 Cr inventory in FY25 indicate a substantial pivot toward trading activity, not pure telephony services — margin durability question.

signals.label: Related parties
signals.text: ₹11.9 Cr expense with Appynitty Communications (KMP-influenced entity); gross related-party transaction value ₹44.2 Cr per AS-18 disclosure.

signals.label: EPFO trail
signals.text: EPFO filings stop at wage month Mar 2020 (33 employees, payments credited 9–12 months late) despite ₹26.7 Cr employee benefit expense and 39 reported employees in FY25 — establishment code change or contribution lapse; verify.

signals.label: Litigation
signals.text: Active cluster: Bombay HC arbitration, a Supreme Court SLP, six municipal-body arbitrations (as claimant); historical cheque-bounce (NI Act) matters — all disposed.

signals.label: Notable shareholder
signals.text: Tata Elxsi Limited holds 10.01% (constant since at least FY2021).
